_comment: Pomnia Slavic green logo concepts — MCP uses built-in FLUX handler; this file is prompt/workflow reference.

_pomnia.post_process: User picks direction first; then refine 2-3x, vectorize, gen-icon.mjs
_pomnia.recommended_mcp_flat: generate_image_smart style=icon size=512x512 workflow=flux lora=flat-ui background=dark_navy project_style=false quality_tier=final
_pomnia.recommended_mcp_depth: generate_image_smart style=icon size=512x512 workflow=flux lora=none background=dark_navy project_style=false quality_tier=final asset_type=icon composition_lock=forbid=flat design,minimalist vector,corporate app icon,gradient squircle,dribbble,behance flat,Lory style

_style_bible: Pomnia Slavic memory vault: forest emerald #1a5c3a, moss #3d6b4f, birch #a8c4b0, amber #c9a227, void #0a120e. Dimensional depth, subtle emboss engraving, organic texture moss bark amber resin, hand-crafted Slavic folk art influence, carved wood or amber inlay, atmospheric rim lighting. Symbolic object with depth — NOT flat vector, NOT illustration scene. No cliche eagles wolves kolovrat Futhark, no purple cyan, no text, no light bulb.
_style_bible_flat_archive: Flat vector icon — DEPRECATED after user feedback (Lory/flat-ui too generic). Use depth pass instead.
_negative: text, watermark, light bulb, lamp, human, face, hands, purple, cyan, magenta, teal, letter R, kolovrat, swastika, landscape scene, trees background, flat design, minimalist vector logo, corporate app icon, gradient squircle, generic tech logo, dribbble logo, behance flat icon, simple geometric mark, Lory style, flat-ui, material design icon

_mcp_settings_depth.composition_lock: forbid=flat design,minimalist vector,corporate app icon,gradient squircle,dribbble,behance flat,Lory style
